specific_competence_name: Develop the understanding of Chinese language basics and principles
learning_activity_name: Pronounce simple minimal pair sentences (example tongue twisters and couplet)
sla_assessment_criteria: Simple minimal pair sentences are pronounced accurately (example tongue twisters).
sla_teaching_aids: YouTube|Recorded text|Written materials|Use of downloaded video from YouTube that show tongue twisters
sla_references: TET(2023), CHINESE LANGUAGE SYLLABUS FOR ADVANCED SECONDARY EDUCATION, TET, DAR ES SALAAM
sla_notes_intro: Minimal pair sentences and tongue twisters (绕口令) train learners to hear and produce the small sound differences that change meaning in Mandarin. Regular practice improves tones, initials and finals.
sla_notes_details: Mandarin has four tones plus a neutral tone: mā (妈, mother), má (麻, hemp), mǎ (马, horse), mà (骂, scold). Tone sandhi matters: two third tones in a row change the first to second tone (你好 is said ní hǎo), 不 becomes bú before a fourth tone (不是 bú shì) and 一 becomes yí before a fourth tone (一个 yí gè). Common contrasts are z/c/s versus zh/ch/sh and j/q/x. Learners read a tongue twister slowly, then faster, checking tone, breath and mouth position.
sla_notes_illustrations: Tongue twister: 四是四，十是十，十四是十四，四十是四十 (sì shì sì, shí shì shí, shíwǔ shì shíwǔ, sìshí shì sìshí). The pair 四 (sì) and 十 (shí) contrasts the s and sh initials and the fourth and second tones. Another: 吃葡萄不吐葡萄皮 (chī pútao bù tǔ pútao pí).
sla_notes_daily_life: Clear pronunciation lets you order food, ask directions or greet a Chinese colleague without being misunderstood, since a wrong tone can change 买 (mǎi, buy) into 卖 (mài, sell).
sla_exercise: How many tones does Mandarin have, excluding the neutral tone?::Four.||Explain the tone change in 你好.::Two third tones in a row: the first is pronounced as a second tone, ní hǎo.||What is the difference in meaning between mǎi and mài?::买 (mǎi) means to buy and 卖 (mài) means to sell.||Read and translate 四是四，十是十.::Sì shì sì, shí shì shí: four is four, ten is ten.

sla_name: Words with the same meaning but different writing
sla_assessment_criteria: Words with the same meanings but different orthography are identified correctly.
sla_teaching_aids: YouTube|Recorded text|Written materials|Use of downloaded video from YouTube that show tongue twisters etc
sla_references: TET(2023), CHINESE LANGUAGE SYLLABUS FOR ADVANCED SECONDARY EDUCATION, TET, DAR ES SALAAM
sla_notes_intro: Chinese has many words that mean nearly the same but are written with different characters or forms. Recognising them enriches vocabulary and style.
sla_notes_details: Such words include synonyms (同义词) such as 说 and 讲 (both mean to speak), 看 and 瞧 (to look), 爸爸 and 父亲 (father, one informal and one formal), 大 and 巨 (big). Other cases are simplified and traditional forms of the same character (国 and 國, 学 and 學) and variant characters (吃 and 喫). Learners note differences in register (formal or spoken), collocation and tone. They use TIPS (Think, Ink, Pair, Share) to list pairs and then discuss them after intensive reading of a passage.
sla_notes_illustrations: In the sentence 他讲了一个故事 the verb 讲 could be replaced by 说 without changing the meaning, but 父亲 is preferred to 爸爸 in a formal speech: 我的父亲是一位教师.
sla_notes_daily_life: In daily life you meet 妈妈 with your friends but 母亲 in a school essay or a newspaper article; knowing both makes you understand and choose the right style.
sla_exercise: Give two words that are synonyms of 说.::讲 and 谈 (also 告诉 in some contexts).||What is the formal word for 爸爸?::父亲 (fùqin).||Write the traditional form of 国.::國.||What does TIPS stand for in this lesson?::Think, Ink, Pair, Share.

sla_notes_intro: Some Chinese characters and words have the same form but different pronunciations and meanings (多音字) or several meanings depending on context (一词多义). Learners identify them from the surrounding text.
sla_notes_details: Polyphonic characters include 行 (xíng, to walk or be fine; háng, row or profession), 长 (cháng, long; zhǎng, to grow), 重 (zhòng, heavy; chóng, again), 好 (hǎo, good; hào, to like), 了 (le, particle; liǎo, to finish) and 得 (de, structural particle; dé, to get; děi, must). Polysemy is also common: 打 appears in 打球 (play ball), 打电话 (make a phone call) and 打伞 (hold an umbrella). After reading a passage, learners identify the correct reading from grammar and context.
sla_notes_illustrations: 我长大了 (wǒ zhǎng dà le, I have grown up) and 这条路很长 (zhè tiáo lù hěn cháng, this road is very long) contain the same character 长 with two sounds and meanings.
sla_notes_daily_life: When reading a shop sign such as 银行 (yínháng, bank) you must choose the right sound of 行; choosing wrongly would change the meaning.
sla_exercise: Give two readings of 行 and their meanings.::xíng (to walk, be all right) and háng (row, line, bank in 银行).||How do you read 长 in 校长?::zhǎng (head of a school).||What does 打 mean in 打电话?::To make a phone call.||What is a 多音字?::A character with more than one pronunciation.

specific_competence_name: Develop the understanding of Chinese language basics and principles
learning_activity_name: Write the Chinese character with 18- 19 strokes
sla_assessment_criteria: Chinese characters with 18-19 strokes are written.
sla_teaching_aids: YouTube|Recorded text|Written materials|Use of downloaded video from YouTube that show tongue twisters etc
sla_references: TET(2023), CHINESE LANGUAGE SYLLABUS FOR ADVANCED SECONDARY EDUCATION, TET, DAR ES SALAAM
sla_notes_intro: Characters with many strokes must be written in the correct stroke order to remain balanced and readable. At this stage learners practise those with 18 to 19 strokes.
sla_notes_details: General stroke-order rules are: top before bottom, left before right, horizontal before vertical when they cross, outside before inside, and close a box last. Complex characters are best learned by dividing them into components (部件). 翻 (fān, to turn) has 18 strokes and is built from 番 and 羽. 覆 (fù, to cover) and 鞭 (biān, whip) also have 18 strokes. 警 (jǐng, to warn), 爆 (bào, explode), 疆 (jiāng, border) and 攀 (pān, to climb) have 19 strokes. Learners practise on grid paper and through games.
sla_notes_illustrations: Write 警察 (jǐngchá, police): 警 has 19 strokes and is made from 敬 above and 言 below; 察 has 14 strokes. Count the strokes out loud while writing each part.
sla_notes_daily_life: You meet these characters in daily life on signs such as 警察局 (police station) or 爆炸 (explosion) warnings, so being able to write and recognise them is useful.
sla_exercise: How many strokes does 翻 have?::18.||Which component of 警 is on the bottom?::言.||State two rules of stroke order.::Top before bottom and left before right (also outside before inside).||Write a word that contains the character 爆.::爆炸 (explosion) or 爆发 (erupt).

learning_activity_name: Infer meaning of unfamiliar words from a complex oral text
sla_name: Inferring the meaning of unfamiliar words from oral texts
sla_assessment_criteria: Meaning of unfamiliar words from a complex oral text are inferred.
sla_teaching_aids: Picture|Recorded text|Reading text|Recorded audio
sla_references: TET(2023), CHINESE LANGUAGE SYLLABUS FOR ADVANCED SECONDARY EDUCATION, TET, DAR ES SALAAM
sla_notes_intro: When listening to speeches, interviews or films, learners often meet new words. They can infer meaning from context, tone and the structure of the word without stopping to look everything up.
sla_notes_details: Useful strategies are: listening for the whole sentence, noticing words before and after the unknown word, recognising familiar morphemes inside compound words, and noting the speaker's tone and gestures. Learners take notes of unknown words to check later, then discuss them in groups or through case studies and scenarios such as a court, hotel or market. Repeated listening helps confirm the guess.
sla_notes_illustrations: In a speech the speaker says 他很勤俭，从不浪费一分钱. Even if 勤俭 is new, the phrase 从不浪费一分钱 (never wastes a cent) shows it means hardworking and thrifty.
sla_notes_daily_life: When you listen to the radio or a Chinese friend's conversation you can follow the story even if some words are new, using this skill.
sla_exercise: Name two clues used to infer meaning in listening.::Context around the word and the speaker's tone (or familiar parts of the word).||Why do learners note down unfamiliar words?::To check their meaning later and add them to their vocabulary.||Guess the meaning of 勤俭 in the example.::Hardworking and thrifty.||How does repeated listening help?::It confirms or corrects the guess about the meaning.

sla_notes_intro: In reading, the writing system itself offers clues, because many characters contain meaning components (radicals) and many words are compounds of known characters.
sla_notes_details: Learners look at radicals: 氵 relates to water (河, 海), 讠to speech (说, 话), 木 to wood or trees (树, 桌), 心 to feelings (想, 爱). They also split compound words into known parts: 图书馆 (picture, book, hall) is library and 火车站 (fire, vehicle, station) is train station. Context in the paragraph, punctuation and parallel structure give further hints. Learners record new words in a notebook and discuss them in groups.
sla_notes_illustrations: In the text 医院里有很多护士 the word 护士 is new. The radical 手 in 护 and the location 医院 suggest a person who takes care of patients, so 护士 means nurse.
sla_notes_daily_life: Reading a menu, notice or product label becomes easier: 饭店 (restaurant) contains 饭 (food) and 店 (shop).
sla_exercise: What does the radical 氵 usually indicate?::Something related to water.||Break down 图书馆 to guess its meaning.::图 picture, 书 book, 馆 hall: library.||How does context help with unknown words?::Surrounding words and sentences give hints about the word's meaning.||Which character contains the radical 讠?::说 or 话 (any word related to speech).

sla_method: Role play and simulation and Debate

sla_teaching_aids: YouTube|Recorded text|Reading text|Recorded audio|Downloaded video from YouTube with related content
sla_references: TET(2023), CHINESE LANGUAGE SYLLABUS FOR ADVANCED SECONDARY EDUCATION, TET, DAR ES SALAAM
sla_notes_intro: Learners use appropriate vocabulary and grammar to speak in familiar settings such as school, home, the market and the hospital.
sla_notes_details: Basic sentence pattern is subject-verb-object. Common patterns include 我想…(I want to), 请问…(may I ask), 多少钱？ (how much), 我头疼 (I have a headache), and measure words such as 一个, 两斤, 三本. Politeness expressions are 请, 谢谢, 对不起, 不客气. Learners practise through role play and simulation of a market or a hospital, through debate on interesting topics and through the silent-way principle: the teacher speaks little and learners speak a lot.
sla_notes_illustrations: Market dialogue: 顾客：这个苹果多少钱？ 摊主：五块钱一斤。 顾客：我要两斤。 Hospital dialogue: 医生：你哪里不舒服？ 病人：我头疼，还有点发烧.
sla_notes_daily_life: You can use these dialogues when shopping at Chinese shops in Dar es Salaam or when helping a Chinese visitor find medical care.
sla_exercise: How do you ask 'How much is this?' in Chinese?::这个多少钱？||Translate 我头疼.::I have a headache.||Give two polite expressions.::请, 谢谢 (also 对不起, 不客气).||What is the basic word order of a Chinese sentence?::Subject, verb, object.

sla_assessment_criteria: Advanced grammar and vocabulary are used correctly (tenses and subject-verb agreement) to describe events, objects and situations.
sla_teaching_aids: YouTube|Recorded text|Reading text|Recorded audio|Downloaded video from YouTube with related content
sla_references: TET(2023), CHINESE LANGUAGE SYLLABUS FOR ADVANCED SECONDARY EDUCATION, TET, DAR ES SALAAM
sla_notes_intro: At this level learners use more advanced grammar to describe events, objects and situations. Note that Chinese does not inflect verbs, so tense and agreement are shown by other means.
sla_notes_details: Time is shown by time words and aspect particles: 了 for completed actions (我吃了饭), 过 for experience (我去过北京), 着 for continuing states (门开着), 在 for ongoing action (他在看书), and 会 or 要 for the future (明天会下雨). Subject-verb agreement does not exist in the sense of inflection: the verb form stays the same for all persons (我去，你去，他去) and agreement is shown by word order and consistency of subject and predicate. Time phrases come before the verb. Learners practise the 把 structure (我把书放在桌子上) and comparisons (比).
sla_notes_illustrations: Compare: 昨天我去了市场 (yesterday I went to the market), 现在我在学习 (now I am studying), 明年我要去中国 (next year I will go to China).
sla_notes_daily_life: You use these patterns whenever you tell a story or describe a day: 我昨天买了一件衬衫，明天会穿.
sla_exercise: Which particle marks a completed action?::了.||Which particle shows experience?::过.||Translate: 他在看书.::He is reading (a book).||Do Chinese verbs change with person?::No, the verb form stays the same for all persons.

sla_notes_intro: Learners write short pieces in Chinese using suitable vocabulary and grammar, such as a plan of the day or a dialogue in a cinema, shop or hotel.
sla_notes_details: A good short text has a topic sentence, supporting sentences and a closing. Sequence words such as 首先, 然后, 最后 (first, then, finally) link ideas. Learners use correct punctuation (。，、？！), write characters neatly in squares and aim for texts of about 200 characters. They practise through TIPS, group discussion and jigsaw tasks in which each group writes part of a conversation about going to the cinema, shopping, booking a hotel or buying tickets.
sla_notes_illustrations: Plan of the day: 今天早上我七点起床，然后吃早饭。八点我去学校上课，下午打篮球，晚上写作业。Dialogue: 你好，我要买两张电影票。 好的，一共六十元.
sla_notes_daily_life: You can write a message to a friend, a shopping list or a hotel booking request in Chinese.
sla_exercise: Give three sequence words in Chinese.::首先, 然后, 最后.||What is the length aimed for in the daily plan text?::More than 200 characters.||Write 'I want to buy two tickets'.::我要买两张票.||Name two Chinese punctuation marks.::。and ，(also 、？！).

sla_notes_intro: Learners listen to simple dialogues, news and announcements from formal and informal settings and respond correctly.
sla_notes_details: Before listening they predict the topic; during listening they catch keywords, numbers, names and times; after listening they answer questions or summarise. Visual aids such as videos with subtitles support comprehension, and taking notes helps remember key information and vocabulary. Formal texts (news, announcements) use complete sentences; informal texts (conversation) use shorter sentences and particles such as 吗, 吧, 啊.
sla_notes_illustrations: Short dialogue: A: 请问，图书馆在哪儿？ B: 在教学楼后面，很近。 Learners answer: Where is the library? (Behind the classroom building.) Is it far? (No.)
sla_notes_daily_life: Listening skill helps you follow announcements at an airport or a Chinese TV programme.
sla_exercise: What are the three phases of a listening task?::Before, during and after listening.||Translate 图书馆在哪儿？::Where is the library?||Why take notes while listening?::To remember key information and vocabulary.||Which particle is used to make a question?::吗.

sla_notes_intro: Authentic texts such as emails, blogs, letters and newspapers are written for native readers. Learners practise reading them for gist and detail.
sla_notes_details: Learners skim for the main idea, scan for details and use context to solve difficulties. They meet typical formats: a letter begins 亲爱的… and ends with 此致敬礼 or 祝好, an email has 主题 (subject) and 收件人 (recipient), and a news item answers who, when, where, what and why. They practise through case studies and group tasks in which they find blogs, emails and letters online and learn how they are used.
sla_notes_illustrations: Letter: 亲爱的王明：你好！我在坦桑尼亚一切都好…… 祝你学习进步！ 小林 Learners identify the writer, reader, greeting and purpose.
sla_notes_daily_life: Reading a Chinese newspaper headline or WeChat message uses the same skills.
sla_exercise: How does a Chinese letter usually begin?::With a greeting such as 亲爱的…||Name a closing phrase.::此致敬礼 (or 祝好).||What is skimming?::Reading quickly for the main idea.||Name two authentic text types.::Emails and newspapers (also blogs and letters).

sla_notes_intro: Confident responses need understanding and courage. Learners respond to longer oral messages in formal and informal ways.
sla_notes_details: They pay attention to tone, intonation and body language and identify whether the message is formal or informal. Then they choose suitable expressions: 我同意 (I agree), 我不这样认为 (I do not think so), 请您再说一遍 (please say it again). Scenario work and jigsaw activities let them respond to given oral texts. Autonomy means answering without depending on the teacher, using vocabulary they know or asking for clarification.
sla_notes_illustrations: Message: 各位同学，明天上午九点请到操场集合，参加运动会。Response: 好的，老师，我们会准时到。 Learners also practise asking 请问，需要带什么吗？
sla_notes_daily_life: You can respond to an announcement at school or a phone call with a Chinese-speaking colleague.
sla_exercise: Translate: please say it again.::请您再说一遍.||Give a phrase for 'I agree'.::我同意.||Why is tone important in responding?::It shows politeness and the speaker's attitude.||What does autonomy mean in responding?::Responding independently without help.

sla_notes_intro: In announcements, news and dialogues learners meet unknown expressions. They deduce meaning from listening and reading clues.
sla_notes_details: They use context, the parts of compound words, the topic of the text and other words of similar meaning. In announcements typical expressions are 请注意 (attention), 即将 (about to), 暂停 (suspend); in news 据报道 (reportedly). Working in groups they read many texts to build vocabulary and improve deduction.
sla_notes_illustrations: Station announcement: 请乘客注意，开往北京的列车即将进站. From context 即将 means about to; the train is about to enter the station.
sla_notes_daily_life: Knowing these expressions helps when reading notices or hearing an announcement in a Chinese shop or airport.
sla_exercise: What does 请注意 mean?::Please pay attention.||Deduce 即将 from the example.::About to.||What is 据报道?::According to reports.||What clue do compound words offer?::The meanings of their parts.

sla_notes_intro: Accurate word pronunciation is based on pinyin, the four tones and the neutral tone. Learners listen, imitate and correct.
sla_notes_details: Pinyin consists of initials (声母) and finals (韵母) with tone marks. Important contrasts are aspirated and unaspirated consonants (b/p, d/t, g/k) and retroflex sounds (zh, ch, sh, r). In two-syllable words the tone of each syllable is kept, except for tone sandhi. Learners use brainstorming to explain how tones change, immerse themselves in films and songs and use listen-and-imitate drills.
sla_notes_illustrations: Read: 你好 (nǐ hǎo), 谢谢 (xièxie), 老师 (lǎoshī), 学生 (xuésheng). Note how the second syllable in 谢谢 is neutral. Compare 妈 (mā), 麻 (má), 马 (mǎ), 骂 (mà).
sla_notes_daily_life: Correct pronunciation makes you understood when you speak to Chinese people or use voice input on your phone.
sla_exercise: What are initials and finals?::Initials are the beginning consonants and finals the vowel parts of a syllable in pinyin.||Pronounce and translate 谢谢.::Xièxie: thank you.||Give the four tones on ma.::mā, má, mǎ, mà.||Name a technique to learn native pronunciation.::Listening and imitating films or songs (immersion).

sla_notes_intro: Learners prepare and give short speeches and announcements for school and community events.
sla_notes_details: A speech begins with a greeting (各位老师、同学们，大家好！), states the purpose, gives details and ends with thanks (谢谢大家！). An announcement (通知) includes the event, date, time, place and contact. Learners use polite and formal language, speak clearly and use gestures. They present given speeches and prepare their own announcement to deliver in front of other students.
sla_notes_illustrations: 通知：本周五下午三点在学校礼堂举行汉语歌唱比赛，欢迎大家参加。 学生会 (Announcement: Friday 3 pm in the hall, singing contest, all welcome.)
sla_notes_daily_life: You may announce a meeting in your class or thank guests at a school event.
sla_exercise: How does a speech usually begin?::With a greeting such as 各位老师、同学们，大家好.||What details does an announcement include?::Event, date, time, place and contact.||Translate 欢迎大家参加.::Everyone is welcome to take part.||How should a speech end?::With thanks, e.g. 谢谢大家.

specific_competence_name: Demonstrate the ability to communicate orally
learning_activity_name: Narrate past and future events
sla_assessment_criteria: Past and future events are narrated.
sla_teaching_aids: YouTube|Recorded text|Reading text|Recorded audio|Downloaded video from YouTube with related content
sla_references: TET(2023), CHINESE LANGUAGE SYLLABUS FOR ADVANCED SECONDARY EDUCATION, TET, DAR ES SALAAM
sla_notes_intro: Narration means telling events in order. Learners talk about past events and future plans using time words and aspect particles.
sla_notes_details: For the past use 昨天, 上个星期, 去年 with 了 or 过. For the future use 明天, 下个月, 明年 with 要, 会, 打算. Sequence words 先…然后…最后 keep events in order. Jigsaw tasks ask learners to narrate an unforgettable event and to create a future scenario about their life.
sla_notes_illustrations: 过去：去年暑假我去了桑给巴尔，玩得很开心。 未来：明年我打算考大学，以后想当医生。
sla_notes_daily_life: Telling friends about your holiday or explaining your plans for the future uses these forms.
sla_exercise: Which word marks the future in 明年我要去中国？::要.||Translate: 昨天我去了学校.::Yesterday I went to school.||Give a sequence pattern.::先…然后…最后.||What does 打算 mean?::To plan.

main_competence_name: Communicate effectively in conversations and written texts
specific_competence_name: Demonstrate ability to communicate in writing
learning_activity_name: Prepare different documents such as announcements, official and non-official letters, resume/ curriculum vitae (CV), vote of thanks/welcoming remarks, invitation Cards/ letters, speeches and filling in forms
sla_assessment_criteria: Different documents are prepared (such as announcements, official and non-official letters, resume/ curriculum vitae (CV), word of thanks/welcome note on various events, Fill in forms, invitation Cards/letters, and speeches).
sla_teaching_aids: Picture|Textbooks|Recorded text|Reading text|Recorded audio
sla_references: TET(2023), CHINESE LANGUAGE SYLLABUS FOR ADVANCED SECONDARY EDUCATION, TET, DAR ES SALAAM
sla_notes_intro: Learners prepare common documents: announcements, official and non-official letters, résumé/CV, votes of thanks, welcoming remarks, invitations, speeches and forms.
sla_notes_details: Every document has a fixed format. A letter has 称呼 (greeting), 正文 (body), 结尾 (closing such as 此致敬礼), 署名 (signature) and 日期 (date). An official letter is formal and uses 尊敬的… A CV lists 姓名, 性别, 出生日期, 教育经历, 工作经历 and 联系方式. An invitation (请柬) gives event, time and place. Learners write documents, present them and complete forms.
sla_notes_illustrations: 请柬：谨定于2024年6月10日上午十点在学校礼堂举行毕业典礼，敬请光临。 Learners compare this formal invitation with an informal one to a friend.
sla_notes_daily_life: You may need to write a job application, an invitation or fill in a hotel form.
sla_exercise: Name two parts of a Chinese letter.::称呼 (greeting) and 正文 (body).||What does 尊敬的 show?::A formal, respectful greeting.||What information is on a CV?::Name, education, work experience and contacts.||What is 请柬?::An invitation card.

specific_competence_name: Translate complex texts
learning_activity_name: Translate a variety of documents (e.g. fliers, brochures, posters, banners, speeches, invitation Cards/ letters, resume/ curriculum vitae (CV), reports, contracts, and wills)
sla_assessment_criteria: Variety of documents are translated (e.g. fliers, brochures, posters, banners, speeches, invitation Cards/ letters, resume/ curriculum vitae (CV), reports, academic reports, contracts, and wills).
sla_teaching_aids: Pictures|Recorded text|Reading text|Recorded audio
sla_references: TET(2023), CHINESE LANGUAGE SYLLABUS FOR ADVANCED SECONDARY EDUCATION, TET, DAR ES SALAAM
sla_notes_intro: Translation transfers meaning from one language to another. Learners translate documents such as fliers, brochures, posters, banners, speeches, invitation cards, résumés, reports, contracts and wills.
sla_notes_details: Translation principles are faithfulness (信), fluency (达) and elegance (雅). Steps: read the whole text, identify text type and audience, translate meaning and not word for word, check terminology and format, and proofread. Learners brainstorm the meaning of translation, form groups to translate documents and discuss short texts. For contracts and wills accuracy in terms is essential.
sla_notes_illustrations: Banner: 欢迎光临 becomes 'Welcome' and flier text 特价销售 becomes 'Special sale'. A poster 请勿吸烟 becomes 'No smoking'.
sla_notes_daily_life: Translation is used in shops, tourism and business between Tanzania and China.
sla_exercise: Name the three principles of translation.::信 (faithful), 达 (fluent) and 雅 (elegant).||Translate 请勿吸烟.::No smoking, please.||Why should translators not translate word for word?::Because languages differ in structure and word-for-word translation loses meaning.||Which documents require accurate terms?::Contracts and wills (legal documents).

specific_competence_name: Develop the understanding of Chinese language basics and principles
learning_activity_name: Pronounce complex minimal pair sentences (example tongue twisters)
sla_method: Role play and Imitation and memorization
sla_assessment_criteria: Complex minimal pair sentences are pronounced (example tongue twisters).
sla_teaching_aids: YouTube|Recorded text|Written materials|Use of downloaded video from YouTube that show tongue twisters
sla_references: TET(2023), CHINESE LANGUAGE SYLLABUS FOR ADVANCED SECONDARY EDUCATION, TET, DAR ES SALAAM
sla_notes_intro: Complex tongue twisters combine many similar sounds in a fast rhythm. They are used to reach native-like clarity in tones, retroflex sounds and finals.
sla_notes_details: Learners focus on contrasts such as zh/ch/sh versus z/c/s and on f/h, n/l and the finals in/ing and en/eng. Method: read slowly with correct tones, mark difficult syllables, repeat in small chunks, then increase speed. They use role play, imitation and memorisation, and dramatise the twister. Accuracy first, speed second.
sla_notes_illustrations: 黑化肥发灰，灰化肥发黑 (hēi huàféi fā huī, huī huàféi fā hēi) contrasts h and f and the tones; 吃葡萄不吐葡萄皮，不吃葡萄倒吐葡萄皮 (chī pútao bù tǔ pútao pí, bù chī pútao dào tǔ pútao pí). Another: 石室诗士施氏，嗜狮 (shí shì shī shì shī shì, shì shī) exercises many sh syllables.
sla_notes_daily_life: Clear articulation helps you present, act and speak on radio; it is also a fun language game with friends.
sla_exercise: Which sounds are contrasted in 四是四，十是十?::s and sh (and tones four and two).||What is the recommended order: speed or accuracy first?::Accuracy first, then speed.||Read 吃葡萄不吐葡萄皮 in pinyin.::Chī pútao bù tǔ pútao pí.||Name a pair of finals often confused.::in and ing (or en and eng).

specific_competence_name: Develop the understanding of Chinese language basics and principles
learning_activity_name: Construct sentences with complex structure
sla_assessment_criteria: Sentences with complex structure are constructed.
sla_teaching_aids: YouTube|Recorded text|Written materials|Use of downloaded video from YouTube that show tongue twisters etc
sla_references: TET(2023), CHINESE LANGUAGE SYLLABUS FOR ADVANCED SECONDARY EDUCATION, TET, DAR ES SALAAM
sla_notes_intro: Complex sentences link clauses using conjunctions, paired connectors and modifiers. They express cause, contrast, condition and sequence.
sla_notes_details: Common patterns: 因为…所以… (because…so), 虽然…但是… (although…but), 不但…而且… (not only…but also), 如果…就… (if…then), 只要…就… (as long as), 一边…一边… (while doing two things), 连…也/都… (even). Attributives with 的 come before nouns: 我昨天买的那本书很有意思. Special structures include 把 (disposal) and 被 (passive) sentences. Learners compose sentences in groups and revise them with TIPS.
sla_notes_illustrations: 虽然今天下雨，但是我们还是去了学校。 不但他会说英语，而且会说汉语。 我把作业交给了老师。
sla_notes_daily_life: Complex sentences let you give reasons, argue and describe situations in interviews and essays.
sla_exercise: Complete: 因为下雨，____ 我们不去公园。::所以.||Translate: 不但…而且….::Not only…but also….||What does 把 do in a sentence?::It puts the object before the verb to show how it is handled or affected.||Give an example with 如果…就….::如果明天不下雨，我们就去公园.

specific_competence_name: Develop the understanding of Chinese language basics and principles
learning_activity_name: Write the Chinese character with 20-21 strokes
sla_assessment_criteria: Chinese characters with 20-21 strokes are written.
sla_teaching_aids: YouTube|Recorded text|Written materials|Use of downloaded video from YouTube that show tongue twisters etc
sla_references: TET(2023), CHINESE LANGUAGE SYLLABUS FOR ADVANCED SECONDARY EDUCATION, TET, DAR ES SALAAM
sla_notes_intro: Highly complex characters need careful stroke order and structure. Learners practise those with 20 to 21 strokes.
sla_notes_details: They analyse the structure: 耀 (yào, to shine, 20 strokes) is 光 plus 翟; 躁 (zào, restless, 20 strokes) is 足 plus 喿; 嚷 (rǎng, to shout, 20 strokes) is 口 plus 襄; 露 (lù, dew or to reveal, 21 strokes) is 雨 above 路. They write on grid paper, copy from model, then write from memory. Games and activities such as character puzzles and competitions make practice interesting.
sla_notes_illustrations: 露 has 雨 (8 strokes) on top and 路 (13 strokes) underneath = 21 strokes. Words: 露水 (dew), 暴露 (expose), 表露 (show).
sla_notes_daily_life: You will see these characters in 荣耀 (glory), 暴露 (expose) or 焦躁 (anxious) in texts and news.
sla_exercise: How many strokes does 露 have?::21.||What are the components of 耀?::光 and 翟.||What does 嚷 mean?::To shout.||Why are games used in character practice?::They make repetition interesting and interactive.

specific_competence_name: Develop Chinese language vocabulary
learning_activity_name: Form new word through word formation processes eg (compounding, blending, clipping)
sla_name: Forming new words through word formation
sla_assessment_criteria: New words are formed through word formation processes (e.g. compounding, blending, clipping).
sla_teaching_aids: Recorded text
sla_references: TET(2023), CHINESE LANGUAGE SYLLABUS FOR ADVANCED SECONDARY EDUCATION, TET, DAR ES SALAAM
sla_notes_intro: Chinese constantly creates new words. Compounding, blending and clipping are three key processes.
sla_notes_details: Compounding joins two or more morphemes: 电+话 = 电话 (telephone), 火+车 = 火车 (train), 大+学 = 大学 (university). Blending merges parts of words, often with shortening: 网络+购物 becomes 网购 (online shopping). Clipping shortens long words: 北京大学 becomes 北大, 奥林匹克运动会 becomes 奥运会, 空中小姐 becomes 空姐. Affixation adds suffixes such as 者 (读者, reader), 家 (科学家, scientist), 化 (现代化, modernisation), 性 (重要性, importance). Learners brainstorm ways of word formation and play crossword games.
sla_notes_illustrations: 手+机 = 手机 (mobile phone); 微信 blends 微 (micro) and 信 (message); 网红 is a clipping of 网络红人 (internet celebrity).
sla_notes_daily_life: New words such as 网购 or 手机支付 appear daily in the news and on your phone; knowing how they form helps you understand them.
sla_exercise: Form a compound from 电 and 脑.::电脑 (computer).||What is the clipped form of 北京大学?::北大.||Name two suffixes used to form new words.::者 and 家 (also 化, 性).||What does 网购 mean?::Online shopping.

specific_competence_name: Develop Chinese language vocabulary
learning_activity_name: Infer the meanings of new words using context, technical dictionary, thesaurus and encyclopaedia
sla_name: Inferring the meaning of new words from context and reference works
sla_assessment_criteria: Meanings of new vocabulary using context, technical dictionary, thesaurus and encyclopaedia are inferred.
sla_teaching_aids: Recorded text
sla_references: TET(2023), CHINESE LANGUAGE SYLLABUS FOR ADVANCED SECONDARY EDUCATION, TET, DAR ES SALAAM
sla_notes_intro: Besides context, learners use technical dictionaries, thesauruses and encyclopaedias to confirm meanings of new words.
sla_notes_details: First guess from context, then check with a reference work. Suitable sources are the 现代汉语词典 (Modern Chinese Dictionary), 同义词词林 (thesaurus of synonyms), specialist dictionaries such as a medical dictionary and encyclopaedias such as 百度百科 (Baidu Baike). Learners note the pinyin, part of speech, definition and examples. They record new vocabulary and compare with synonyms.
sla_notes_illustrations: New word 抗生素 in a health text. Context: 医生给病人开了抗生素 (the doctor prescribed…). Dictionary confirms: antibiotics.
sla_notes_daily_life: Using a dictionary app to check a word you read in a news or medical text is an everyday application.
sla_exercise: Name a Chinese thesaurus.::同义词词林.||What does a dictionary entry usually include?::Pinyin, part of speech, meaning and examples.||Why use an encyclopaedia?::To get broad knowledge about a term or topic.||What is the first strategy before consulting a dictionary?::Guess from context.

specific_competence_name: Use appropriate vocabulary and grammar in different contexts
learning_activity_name: Use advanced vocabulary and grammar ( e.g. adverbs, prepositions, conjunctions and measure words) to describe field specific past, present and future events
sla_name: Using advanced vocabulary and grammar to describe past, present and future events
sla_assessment_criteria: Advanced vocabulary and grammar (e.g adverbs, prepositions, conjunctions and measure words) are used to describe field specific past, present and future events.
sla_teaching_aids: Recorded text
sla_references: TET(2023), CHINESE LANGUAGE SYLLABUS FOR ADVANCED SECONDARY EDUCATION, TET, DAR ES SALAAM
sla_notes_intro: At this level learners use adverbs, prepositions, conjunctions and measure words to describe events in specific fields.
sla_notes_details: Adverbs: 已经 (already), 正在 (in the process), 非常 (very), 曾经 (once), 刚刚 (just now). Prepositions: 在 (at), 从 (from), 对 (to), 关于 (about), 按照 (according to). Conjunctions: 而且, 但是, 因此. Measure words: 一本书, 一位老师, 一辆车, 一杯水, 一条河, 一封信. In field-specific description learners use technical vocabulary: economy (经济), health (卫生), environment (环境). They debate, demonstrate real-life interpersonal communication and retell scenarios.
sla_notes_illustrations: 过去：政府去年已经修建了这条公路。 现在：工人们正在检查设备。 将来：明年这里将建一所新医院。
sla_notes_daily_life: You can describe a project at school or report news about your town using such forms.
sla_exercise: Give the measure word for 书 (book).::本.||Which adverb means 'already'?::已经.||Translate 关于环境问题.::About environmental problems.||Which conjunction means 'therefore'?::因此.

specific_competence_name: Use appropriate vocabulary and grammar in different contexts
learning_activity_name: Compose a passage using appropriate vocabulary and grammar themed on a particular context (e.g. school, home, hospital, national park, museum, gym/playground)
sla_name: Composing a passage on a particular context
sla_assessment_criteria: A passage is composed using appropriate vocabulary and grammar on a particular context (e.g. school, home, hospital, national park, museum, gym/playground).
sla_teaching_aids: Recorded text
sla_references: TET(2023), CHINESE LANGUAGE SYLLABUS FOR ADVANCED SECONDARY EDUCATION, TET, DAR ES SALAAM
sla_notes_intro: Learners write a passage of less than 300 characters on a specific context such as school, home, hospital, national park, museum or gym.
sla_notes_details: Steps: choose the theme, gather vocabulary, plan an outline (开头, 正文, 结尾), write using suitable grammar, and check tones? No: check characters, measure words and punctuation. Learners write in jigsaw groups and join composition competitions. Descriptions of place use 有, 在, 里面, 旁边, 附近 and sensory words.
sla_notes_illustrations: 我们的学校 —— 我们学校在城市中心，有一栋教学楼和一个大操场。每天早上同学们在操场上做操。我喜欢我们的学校，因为老师和同学都很友好。 (Our school...)
sla_notes_daily_life: You can describe your neighbourhood, the Serengeti National Park (塞伦盖蒂国家公园) or a museum visit to a Chinese pen friend.
sla_exercise: What is the length of the passage?::Less than 300 characters.||Give a word meaning 'next to'.::旁边.||What are the three parts of a passage?::开头 (beginning), 正文 (body), 结尾 (ending).||Translate 塞伦盖蒂国家公园.::Serengeti National Park.

specific_competence_name: Use appropriate vocabulary and grammar in different contexts
learning_activity_name: Write an essay using appropriate vocabulary and grammar based on a particular topic (e.g environmental pollution, diseases, corruption)
sla_name: Writing an essay on a particular topic
sla_assessment_criteria: An essay using appropriate vocabulary and grammar based on a particular topic (e.g environmental pollution, diseases, corruption) are written.
sla_teaching_aids: Recorded text
sla_references: TET(2023), CHINESE LANGUAGE SYLLABUS FOR ADVANCED SECONDARY EDUCATION, TET, DAR ES SALAAM
sla_notes_intro: An essay develops an argument on a topic such as environmental pollution, diseases or corruption in a clear structure.
sla_notes_details: An essay has an introduction that states the issue, body paragraphs that give causes, effects and examples, and a conclusion that suggests solutions. Connecting words: 首先, 其次, 最后, 另外, 总之. Learners use a project task where each student receives a title and writes with proper vocabulary: 污染 (pollution), 疾病 (disease), 腐败 (corruption), 措施 (measures). Essays should stay on topic, be logical and use correct punctuation.
sla_notes_illustrations: 环境污染 — 开头：环境污染越来越严重。 正文：首先，工厂排放废气；其次，人们乱扔垃圾。 结尾：总之，我们应该保护环境，从我做起。
sla_notes_daily_life: Essays develop your ability to reason and are used in examinations and applications.
sla_exercise: Give three connecting words used in essays.::首先, 其次, 总之.||Translate 环境污染.::Environmental pollution.||What does the conclusion of an essay do?::Summarises and suggests solutions.||Write the Chinese for 'corruption'.::腐败.

main_competence_name: Demonstrate higher understanding of Chinese language in conversation and written texts
specific_competence_name: Develop understanding of Chinese language conversations and texts
learning_activity_name: Infer different kinds of meanings of words e.g. (denotative, connotative, figurative) from oral information and written texts
sla_name: Inferring denotative, connotative and figurative meanings
sla_assessment_criteria: Different kinds of meanings of words (e.g. denotative, connotative, figurative) are inferred from oral information and written texts.
sla_teaching_aids: Recorded text|Reading text
sla_references: TET(2023), CHINESE LANGUAGE SYLLABUS FOR ADVANCED SECONDARY EDUCATION, TET, DAR ES SALAAM
sla_notes_intro: Words carry different kinds of meaning. Learners distinguish denotative (外延), connotative (内涵) and figurative (比喻) meanings from oral and written texts.
sla_notes_details: Denotative meaning is the dictionary meaning; connotative meaning is the emotional or cultural association; figurative meaning is a non-literal use such as metaphor. Example: 狼 denotes the animal wolf; it connotes greed and cruelty; 他是一只狼 is figurative. 红 denotes the colour red; in Chinese culture it connotes luck and celebration; 红人 is a popular person. Learners listen to a context, identify the meanings in groups and present them.
sla_notes_illustrations: 龙 denotes a dragon; it connotes power and good fortune in China; 望子成龙 is figurative: hope one's child becomes a success.
sla_notes_daily_life: You interpret advertisements and songs by recognising these meanings.
sla_exercise: What is denotative meaning?::The literal dictionary meaning.||Give the connotation of 红 in Chinese culture.::Luck and celebration.||What is a figurative meaning?::A non-literal meaning such as a metaphor.||Explain 他是一只狼.::He is greedy or fierce (figurative).

main_competence_name: Demonstrate higher understanding of Chinese language in conversation and written texts
specific_competence_name: Develop understanding of Chinese language conversations and texts
learning_activity_name: Recognize the main ideas, opinions, emotions and attitudes from oral and written texts themed on daily routine (e.g. personal, family, shopping and leisure activities)
sla_name: Recognising main ideas, opinions, emotions and attitudes
sla_assessment_criteria: Main ideas, opinions, emotions and attitudes from oral and written texts themed on everyday topics are recognized (e.g personal, family, shopping and leisure activities).
sla_teaching_aids: Recorded text|Reading text
sla_references: TET(2023), CHINESE LANGUAGE SYLLABUS FOR ADVANCED SECONDARY EDUCATION, TET, DAR ES SALAAM
sla_notes_intro: Learners identify what a speaker or writer thinks and feels about everyday topics such as personal life, family, shopping and leisure.
sla_notes_details: Main idea is the central message; an opinion expresses a judgment (我觉得, 我认为); emotion is shown by words like 高兴, 难过, 生气 and particles like 啊, 呢; attitude is shown by tone and choice of words. Learners use audio-visual materials and poems and songs, role play emotional expression using intonation, and discuss in jigsaw groups.
sla_notes_illustrations: 他说：我觉得网购很方便，可是有时候质量不好。 Main idea: online shopping is convenient; opinion: convenient but sometimes poor quality; attitude: balanced.
sla_notes_daily_life: Understanding attitudes helps in conversation and in reading reviews or letters.
sla_exercise: Give two phrases that introduce opinions.::我觉得 and 我认为.||Which word shows the emotion 'happy'?::高兴.||What is an attitude?::A speaker's stance or feeling towards something.||Identify the opinion in 我认为运动很重要.::Sport is important.

main_competence_name: Demonstrate higher understanding of Chinese language in conversation and written texts
specific_competence_name: Develop understanding of Chinese language conversations and texts
learning_activity_name: Retell, rewrite and summarize the story heard from oral presentation or read text
sla_assessment_criteria: Stories heard from oral presentations or read texts are retold and rewritten.
sla_teaching_aids: Recorded text|Reading text
sla_references: TET(2023), CHINESE LANGUAGE SYLLABUS FOR ADVANCED SECONDARY EDUCATION, TET, DAR ES SALAAM
sla_notes_intro: Retelling is telling a story again orally, rewriting is writing it in your own words and summarising is giving its main points briefly.
sla_notes_details: For retelling, list the key events in order and use 先…然后…最后. For rewriting, change form, person or style while keeping the meaning. For summarising (概括), remove details and keep who, what, when, where and why, reducing text to about one third. Learners use case studies and group reading.
sla_notes_illustrations: Story: 小明捡到钱包，找到失主，把钱包还给了他。Summary: 小明拾金不昧 (Xiao Ming found a wallet and returned it).
sla_notes_daily_life: Summarising helps you report what you heard in a meeting or read in a book.
sla_exercise: What is retelling?::Telling a story again in your own words.||Which idiom means returning found money?::拾金不昧.||How long should a summary be roughly?::About one third of the original.||Which sequence words help in retelling?::先, 然后, 最后.

main_competence_name: Demonstrate higher understanding of Chinese language in conversation and written texts
specific_competence_name: Develop understanding of Chinese language conversations and texts
learning_activity_name: Deduce rhetorical and implied meanings from conversations
sla_assessment_criteria: Rhetorical and implied meanings from conversations are deduced.
sla_teaching_aids: Recorded text|Reading text
sla_references: TET(2023), CHINESE LANGUAGE SYLLABUS FOR ADVANCED SECONDARY EDUCATION, TET, DAR ES SALAAM
sla_notes_intro: Speakers often say more than the words show. Rhetorical questions, irony and hints carry implied meaning.
sla_notes_details: A rhetorical question (反问句) expects no answer and stresses a point: 难道你不知道吗？ means you must know. Irony (反语) says the opposite: 你真聪明 said after a mistake means you were careless. Implied meaning (言外之意) is understood from context: 这里有点冷 may be a request to close the window. Learners brainstorm meanings, read conversations in groups and deduce what the speaker means.
sla_notes_illustrations: 妈妈：这个房间是猪窝吗？ Implied meaning: the room is very untidy, please clean it.
sla_notes_daily_life: You avoid misunderstandings in conversation when you notice hints and irony.
sla_exercise: What is a rhetorical question?::A question asked for effect that does not need an answer.||What does 难道你不知道吗 imply?::You must know.||What is 言外之意?::Implied meaning.||What is irony?::Saying the opposite of what one means.

main_competence_name: Communicate effectively in conversations and written texts
specific_competence_name: Demonstrate the ability to communicate orally
learning_activity_name: Participate in debate and interview on various topics
sla_assessment_criteria: Debates and interviews on various topics are participated in.
sla_teaching_aids: YouTube|Recorded text|Reading text|Recorded audio|Downloaded video from YouTube with related content
sla_references: TET(2023), CHINESE LANGUAGE SYLLABUS FOR ADVANCED SECONDARY EDUCATION, TET, DAR ES SALAAM
sla_notes_intro: Debate and interview are structured forms of speaking that train persuasion, listening and quick thinking.
sla_notes_details: In a debate there are 正方 (affirmative) and 反方 (negative) teams, a motion (辩题), opening statements, rebuttals and closing. Language includes 我方认为, 对方辩友, 因此. Interviews have an interviewer (采访者) and interviewee (受访者) with questions such as 请问, 您怎么看…, 谢谢您接受采访. Learners join debate competitions and role play an interview.
sla_notes_illustrations: 辩题：中学生应该带手机上学吗？ 正方：应该，因为可以查资料。 反方：不应该，因为影响学习。
sla_notes_daily_life: These skills prepare you for interviews, meetings and public discussions.
sla_exercise: What is 正方 and 反方?::Affirmative and negative teams.||Translate 对方辩友.::Opposing debater.||Give a polite way to start an interview question.::请问…||Name the two roles in an interview.::Interviewer and interviewee.

sla_notes_intro: Acting lets learners practise expressive language: shouting, yelling, crying out, speaking up and frank talk.
sla_notes_details: Verbal expressions: 大喊 (shout), 尖叫 (scream), 哭诉 (cry out with complaints), 大声说 (speak loudly), 直言不讳 (speak frankly). Intonation, exclamation marks and particles (啊, 吧, 啦) show emotion. Learners watch a conversation, imitate it, and dramatise a theme such as an argument or an accident, using suitable voice and gestures.
sla_notes_illustrations: 小明大喊：救命啊！ 老师直言不讳地说：你这次考试没有认真复习。 Learners act both.
sla_notes_daily_life: Drama builds confidence and helps you express emotion naturally in real life.
sla_exercise: What does 直言不讳 mean?::To speak frankly without hiding anything.||Translate 救命啊！::Help!||Give a word for 'to shout'.::大喊.||Which particles express emotion?::啊, 吧, 啦.

sla_notes_intro: Complex texts such as investigative reports, academic reports, contracts, wills and manuals need precise language, structure and punctuation.
sla_notes_details: Investigative report: background, method, findings, conclusion. Academic report: title, abstract, introduction, body, references. Contract: parties, terms, rights and duties, signatures, date; wills state the testator and heirs. Manuals give steps with numbers and imperative verbs. Correct punctuation is vital: 。， 、；：？！ “ ” 《》（）. Learners present drafts and write short stories about past events in groups.
sla_notes_illustrations: 合同：甲方（卖方）：……；乙方（买方）：……。 第一条：货物名称与数量……。 说明书：第一步，打开电源；第二步，按下开始键。
sla_notes_daily_life: You may write a report for school or a contract for a business one day.
sla_exercise: Name the parts of a report.::Background, method, findings and conclusion.||Which punctuation is used for book titles?::《 》.||Who are 甲方 and 乙方?::The first and second party in a contract.||Why is punctuation important in contracts?::Because a misplaced mark can change the meaning.

sla_notes_intro: Computer-assisted translation (CAT) tools help translators work faster and more consistently.
sla_notes_details: CAT tools include translation memory (翻译记忆库), which stores previous translations, terminology databases (术语库), machine translation (机器翻译) and quality checks. Examples: Trados, memoQ, Google Translate and Baidu Translate. The translator reviews machine output through post-editing (译后编辑). Learners brainstorm the tools and translate texts in groups, comparing tool output and correcting mistakes.
sla_notes_illustrations: The tool suggests 'Hello' for 你好 and 'Prevent the fire' for 防火: the translator edits it to 'Fire prevention' according to context.
sla_notes_daily_life: Translators, offices and students use these tools for quick, consistent work, but human review remains necessary.
sla_exercise: What is translation memory?::A database of previous translations that can be reused.||What is post-editing?::Correcting machine translation output.||Name one CAT tool.::Trados (or memoQ).||Why is human review still needed?::Machines may make errors in meaning and style.

sla_assessment_criteria: Complex oral texts (e.g. speeches, announcements, classroom conversations/ dialogues, and interview) are interpreted.
sla_teaching_aids: Text
sla_references: TET(2023), CHINESE LANGUAGE SYLLABUS FOR ADVANCED SECONDARY EDUCATION, TET, DAR ES SALAAM
sla_notes_intro: Interpreting means conveying spoken messages orally into another language at once. Learners interpret speeches, announcements, classroom conversations and interviews.
sla_notes_details: Types: consecutive interpreting (交替传译), where the interpreter listens and then speaks, and simultaneous interpreting (同声传译), where interpreting is almost at once. Skills: active listening, note-taking symbols, memory, paraphrasing and accuracy of numbers and names. Principles: faithfulness, neutrality and confidentiality. Learners use TIPS to state the principles and practise with dialogues.
sla_notes_illustrations: A: 欢迎各位来到我们学校。 Interpreter: Welcome everyone to our school. Notes: 欢迎 → W, 学校 → sch.
sla_notes_daily_life: Interpreters work at conferences, visits, courts and hospitals when two people do not share a language.
sla_exercise: Name two kinds of interpreting.::Consecutive (交替传译) and simultaneous (同声传译).||Why do interpreters take notes?::To remember details like numbers and names.||State two interpreter principles.::Faithfulness and confidentiality (or neutrality).||Interpret 欢迎光临.::Welcome.
